description: Pinned Unicode repertoire transcribed from libcaption v0.8's published CEA-608 character-set table. This is a deterministic Unicode membership dataset, not a CEA-608 byte encoder or a claim of end-to-end delivery compliance.

sources.source_scope: Published Basic North American, Special North American, and Extended Western European character repertoires implemented by this converter.
Normative reference only; its character tables are not reproduced here.

redistribution.required_notice: Copyright 2016-2017 Twitch Interactive, Inc. or its affiliates. Licensed under the MIT License; retain the copyright and permission notice when redistributing this derived repertoire data.
redistribution.modification_notice: This JSON reformats the published repertoire as Unicode scalar records. It does not copy the ANSI/CEA standard tables and does not include converter code.

record_contract.ordering: character_sets is source-table order; glyphs is source-table order within each set.
record_contract.glyph_encoding: Each glyph is one Unicode scalar value encoded as a JSON string; U+00A0 is represented as \u00a0.
record_contract.membership_rule: A glyph is mechanically supported only when its exact Unicode scalar is present in at least one character-set glyphs array. No normalization, substitution, transliteration, replacement, or dropping is permitted by this lookup.

verification_boundaries.claim_gate: Do not claim CEA-608-compatible authoring or delivery from this data alone. P05 may report exact glyph membership only; C4 requires encoder, transport, and acceptance evidence.

not_listed_glyph_disposition.required_behavior: Retain the original glyph in draft output and report its code point and source position. Do not replace, transliterate, omit, or assert that the normative CEA-608 standard rejects it without separately verified evidence.
